# Qatar eAIP pages, as served

Retrieved 07 SEP 2026 from `aim.gov.qa` by an operator on a network that can
reach the host, and stored **unmodified**. The build environment's egress
policy blocks the host, so these are the only first-hand evidence of Qatar's
layout that this repository holds.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `history-en-GB.html` | the edition history — the one address treated as known |
| `index-en-GB.html` | an edition's index. A 1,201-byte frameset with no anchors |
| `QA-menu-en-GB.html` | the contents, two hops in. 80 sections and three companion tabs |

Three things these disproved, each of which had been inferred and was wrong:

1. The index carries the contents. It does not — it is a frameset.
2. Anchors name pages. They name *elements*: `QA-GEN-0.1-en-GB.html#i197343`.
3. Supplements live in the AIP tree. They live under `eSUP/` and `eAIC/`,
   reached from tabs on the menu.

Kept because a State's real markup is the only thing that finds defects like
those, and Qatar keeps no archive of its own — its expired-issues list reads
`NIL`, so these pages are unrecoverable once the edition is withdrawn.
